title: names
summary: Benilla's names writer has three ask-once queries: CMSG_NAME_QUERY (full guid), CMSG_CREATURE_QUERY (entry+guid), CMSG_PET_NAME_QUERY (pet number+guid). MSUI implements the first two with their SMSG responses handled; the pet-name pair is absent.

openItems.text: CMSG_PET_NAME_QUERY (u32 petNumber + u64 guid) has no sender - a pet's guid embeds a pet number, not a template entry, so CreatureQuery cannot name one
SMSG_PET_NAME_QUERY_RESPONSE not parsed (pets/other players' pets stay nameless)
